entities.summary: Sergei Mikhailovich Abramov is a Russian mathematician, Professor, Dr.Sc., Corresponding Member of the Russian Academy of Sciences, Director of the Institute of Program Systems of the Russian Academy of Sciences, Rector of the University of Pereslavl (2003–2017). Specialist in the field of system programming and information technologies.
